questions.question: In a vision of a woman about to give birth, why did the huge red dragon stand before her?

answers.text: To devour her child as soon as it was born
To snatch the crown off her head
To steal the moon from under her feet

questions.question: In a vision of a war in heaven, the dragon was not strong enough to win. True or false?
In a vision of a woman and a dragon, who is the great dragon that was hurled down to the earth?

answers.text: The ancient serpent called the devil

questions.question: In a vision of a dragon, the dragon spewed a river of water to sweep the woman away. What stopped the river?

answers.text: The earth opened up and swallowed it
The sun dried it all up
